params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-updater-e2e-harness-manager'
if (Test-Path $root) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $root }
git clone --no-tags https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $root
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'clone failed' }
git -C $root checkout -b agent/updater-installed-client-e2e-harness-20260929 origin/main
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'branch creation failed' }
$prompt = @'
You own a NARROW verification-infrastructure task for fengie/mhw-mods.

Context:
- Automatic updater publication is CLOSED at exact source 5abe40304dfcb48f96e750bd7da3d0075315625b.
- Immutable target release is updater-main-61.
- Hosted Windows Release Gate 36541891969 passed 25/25.
- Final missing boundary is disposable installed-client E2E:
  A) old -> build 61 with exact restart/build/source identity + health acknowledgement + unchanged Mods/State/unknown-file hashes.
  B) separate deterministic injected-failure rollback proving previous owned bytes/metadata/executable restoration, new-only product cleanup, unchanged seeded data, and safe journal state.
- A direct Heaven execution attempt was BLOCKED because api.github.com:443 is unreachable and no updater release credential is present on heaven. Do NOT retry that same network path.
- GitHub-hosted Windows runners are the intended escape hatch because they have network access and a repository-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN.

Objective:
Implement a purpose-built, disposable HOSTED-WINDOWS E2E harness/workflow on this branch so the two remaining updater scenarios can be executed against the real immutable release(s) without touching any real user/game install.

Hard scope:
- Do NOT modify production C# under src/ unless absolutely necessary to expose an already-existing deterministic test seam; strongly prefer scripts/tests/workflow only.
- Never weaken updater auth, TLS, path, rollback, ownership, or health checks.
- Never touch a real MHW install. Use only runner temp directories and isolated LOCALAPPDATA/application-state paths where possible.
- Do not publish/tag/merge or mutate existing releases.
- Do not alter canonical main directly.
- Do not hardcode secrets. Use ${{ github.token }} / GITHUB_TOKEN only inside GitHub Actions environment and never print it.
- Preserve continuity rules.

Implementation requirements:
1. Inspect current updater source/tests first, especially GitHubUpdateSource, UpdateClientService, UpdateInstaller, UpdateRestartCoordinator, helper Program, package verifier, and existing updater integration tests.
2. Add the smallest maintainable E2E harness that can:
   - acquire immutable old and target release assets from the private repo using the workflow token;
   - independently verify target build/source/artifact identity;
   - create fully disposable old-install roots;
   - seed Mods, State, and an unknown file and record SHA-256;
   - exercise as much of the REAL packaged updater discovery/download/stage/helper/apply/restart/health path as the shipped architecture supports on a hosted Windows runner;
   - verify exact restarted build 61 / source 5abe40304dfcb48f96e750bd7da3d0075315625b and health acknowledgement;
   - prove sentinels unchanged.
3. Add a separate deterministic rollback scenario using an existing supported fault seam or a tightly scoped test-only harness. Do not simulate success. Prove old owned bytes/metadata/executable restored, new-only product files removed, sentinel hashes unchanged, and final journal/recovery state.
4. If updater-main-60 is unavailable/incompatible, choose the nearest valid immutable prior release and state exactly why.
5. Make the workflow run on pull_request and workflow_dispatch, Windows only, least-privilege permissions (contents: read unless more is strictly required), pinned .NET 10.0.401, and upload concise evidence artifacts/logs.
6. Ensure failures are loud. The workflow must not mark green when either scenario is BLOCKED or partially skipped.
7. Add or update continuity documentation describing this exact verification boundary without claiming the E2E passed before CI actually passes.
8. Run local static/syntax/build checks possible on heaven. Do not fabricate hosted results.
9. Commit and push ONLY this branch. Report exact commit SHA, files changed, local checks, and any known hosted-only assumptions.

If you discover the shipped architecture makes true packaged restart/health impossible on a headless runner, still produce the strongest safe harness plus an explicit blocker and acceptance gap; do not weaken the product to make the test pass.
'@
$prompt | codex -a never -s workspace-write exec -C $root -
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'codex harness task failed' }
$changed = git -C $root diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD
if ($changed -match '^src/') { Write-Output 'WARNING: production src changed; inspect before integration' }
git -C $root status --short
git -C $root log -1 --oneline
git -C $root push -u origin agent/updater-installed-client-e2e-harness-20260929
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'push failed' }
Write-Output ('HEAD=' + (git -C $root rev-parse HEAD))
Write-Output 'FILES:'
git -C $root diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD
